title: NCLT Mumbai Sanctions Samvardhana Motherson's Composite Scheme Folding In Three Group Units
case_name: In re: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited (composite scheme of arrangement with Samvardhana Motherson Auto System Private Limited, Motherson Machinery and Automations Limited and other group entities)
citation: Order dated 26 October 2026 under Sections 230 to 232, Companies Act, 2013
card_summary: The Mumbai bench of the NCLT sanctioned Samvardhana Motherson International's composite scheme of arrangement, folding in wholly owned units including Samvardhana Motherson Auto System and Motherson Machinery and Automations. The board had cleared the scheme in February 2025 and the company filed its petition under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013; the tribunal's order closes out that restructuring.
card_tip: Budget a long runway for an intra-group scheme of arrangement; board approval to NCLT sanction took close to twenty months here even with no contest on record.
verification_notes: Confirmed via the company's NSE Regulation 30 filing dated 26 October 2026 (primary) and a secondary report (Investywise) with matching date and scheme description.
